description: Known Koopman eigenfunctions of this system, as data: exact expressions in its state, parameter and dimensionless-group names, with the conditions under which they hold.

references.brunton: Brunton, Brunton, Proctor and Kutz (2016), PLoS ONE 11:e0150171, eqs. 25-27
references.kaiser: Kaiser, Kutz and Brunton (2021), Mach. Learn.: Sci. Technol. 2:035023, eqs. 50-52

eigenfunctions.title: Exact eigenfunction eta
eigenfunctions.conditions: Zero driver; b != 2a (for c = 0, eta = x_2 = principal_b)
eigenfunctions.derivation: eta' = x_2' + 2c x_1 x_1'/(b-2a) = b eta

eigenfunctions.title: Linearized principal eigenfunction at the origin (rate a)
Linearized principal eigenfunction at the origin (rate b)
eigenfunctions.derivation: left eigenvector (0,1) of Df(0); linearization of eta
